title: session.snapshot Body Schema
description: Body schema for session.snapshot command topic. Carries a SessionState COLD tier snapshot for archival to K0 storage.

snapshot_ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when snapshot was captured.

sections.description: Map of section_name to section_data. Each section is a serialized SessionState tier (e.g. beliefs_active, history_active, scoreboard).

additionalProperties.description: Serialized section data. Schema varies per section.

ttl_hint.description: Suggested TTL in seconds for K0 storage retention. 0 = indefinite.

turn_count.description: Number of conversation turns at snapshot time.

compression_algo.description: Compression algorithm used on section data.
